fieldDescription: How the submarket buttons above the cargo and fleet screens are laid out. Stretched: the vanilla number of buttons per row widened to fill the row. Five per row: five buttons with names in each row; names too long for the button are cut short. Unfold on hover (default): icon sized buttons with one button opened to show its name; the button under the cursor opens and the open one folds while the row keeps its width. The last hovered button stays open after the cursor leaves. The storage button always sits at the right end of the last row. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.

How the selected submarket button is marked. Off: as in vanilla. Bright band: a 3 px outline in black then the submarket's color then white. Animated (default): a soft black band with four highlights in the submarket's color running clockwise around it. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
How many seconds Unfold on hover takes to open a button fully (default 0.1). 0 opens it at once. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.

Draws the dark background of the submarket buttons with the same cut corners as their frame instead of the vanilla square corners that show past it. On by default. Changes apply the next time the screen opens.
